````cpp
inline bool checkGlAt(const char* file, int line, PipelineStage stage, const char* api) {
    bool success = true;

    for (GLenum code = gl().GetError(); code != GL_NO_ERROR; code = gl().GetError()) {
        const char* cause =
            code == GL_INVALID_ENUM                    ? "GL_INVALID_ENUM: unsupported enum"
            : code == GL_INVALID_VALUE                 ? "GL_INVALID_VALUE: value outside allowed range"
            : code == GL_INVALID_OPERATION             ? "GL_INVALID_OPERATION: incompatible binding, state or program"
            : code == GL_OUT_OF_MEMORY                 ? "GL_OUT_OF_MEMORY: GPU allocation failed"
            : code == GL_INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION ? "GL_INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION: incomplete framebuffer"
                                                       : "OpenGL error";

        Diagnostics::failAt(
            file, line, stage, api, std::string(cause) + " (" + std::to_string(code) + ")",
            "Inspect this stage's bindings, buffer sizes, vertex layout, shader log and current context. A GL error does not identify a single root cause.");
        success = false;
    }

    return success;
}
} // namespace graphics::detail
````

## openGL_3dAssign_24/framework/detail/ObjLoader.cpp

### 블록 1: before L1, after L1

변경 이유: 실습 폴더 하나로 복사·빌드·실행할 수 있도록 공통 원본의 독립 배포 사본을 포함한다.

**before** (없음)

**after**

````cpp
#include "../Framework.h"
#include "Internal.h"
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <locale>
#include <iterator>
#include <iostream>

namespace graphics::detail {
struct ObjParseError : std::runtime_error {
    using std::runtime_error::runtime_error;
};

struct ObjCorner {
    long long position = 0, uv = 0, normal = 0;

    bool operator==(const ObjCorner& b) const {
        return position == b.position && uv == b.uv && normal == b.normal;
    }
};

struct ObjFace {
    std::vector<ObjCorner> corners;
    std::size_t positions = 0, uvs = 0, normals = 0, line = 0, batch = 0;
    std::string name;
};

void objWarning(std::vector<std::string>& warnings, const std::string& message) {
    if (std::find(warnings.begin(), warnings.end(), message) == warnings.end())
        warnings.push_back(message);
}

long long objInteger(const std::string& text) {
    const auto start = (!text.empty() && (text[0] == '-' || text[0] == '+')) ? 1u : 0u;

    if (start == text.size() || text.find_first_not_of("0123456789", start) != std::string::npos)
        throw ObjParseError("Invalid OBJ index: " + text);

    try {
        const auto value = std::stoll(text);

        if (value == 0)
            throw ObjParseError("OBJ indices start at 1; zero is invalid.");

        return value;
    } catch (const std::out_of_range&) {
        throw ObjParseError("OBJ index is too large.");
    }
}

ObjCorner objCorner(const std::string& text) {
    ObjCorner result;
    const auto a = text.find('/'), b = a == std::string::npos ? a : text.find('/', a + 1);

    if (b != std::string::npos && text.find('/', b + 1) != std::string::npos)
        throw ObjParseError("Too many fields in OBJ corner: " + text);
    result.position = objInteger(text.substr(0, a));

    if (a != std::string::npos) {
        const auto part = text.substr(a + 1, b == std::string::npos ? b : b - a - 1);

        if (!part.empty())
            result.uv = objInteger(part);
        else if (b == std::string::npos)
            throw ObjParseError("Missing UV after '/'.");
    }

    if (b != std::string::npos) {
        if (b + 1 == text.size())
            throw ObjParseError("Missing normal after '//'.");
        result.normal = objInteger(text.substr(b + 1));
    }

    return result;
}

std::size_t objResolve(long long value, std::size_t atFace, std::size_t total, bool compatible) {
    // Negative references use counts at the face, even during the second pass.
    if (value < 0) {
        if (value < -static_cast<long long>(atFace))
            throw ObjParseError("Negative OBJ index is out of range.");

        return std::size_t(static_cast<long long>(atFace) + value);
    }

    if (static_cast<unsigned long long>(value) > (compatible ? total : atFace))
        throw ObjParseError("Positive OBJ index is out of range or references a later record.");

    return std::size_t(value - 1);
}

std::vector<float> objNumbers(std::istringstream& row) {
    std::vector<float> result;
    std::string token;

    while (row >> token) {
        std::istringstream number(token);

        number.imbue(std::locale::classic());

        double value = 0;
        char extra = 0;

        if (!(number >> value) || (number >> extra) || !std::isfinite(value) ||
            std::abs(value) > std::numeric_limits<float>::max())
            throw ObjParseError("Invalid finite OBJ number: " + token);
        result.push_back(float(value));
    }

    return result;
}

std::string objText(const std::string& bytes, bool compatible, std::vector<std::string>& warnings) {
    std::string text = bytes;

    if (bytes.size() >= 2 &&
        ((static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[0]) == 0xff && static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[1]) == 0xfe) ||
         (static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[0]) == 0xfe && static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[1]) == 0xff))) {
        if (!compatible)
            throw ObjParseError("UTF-16 BOM requires the compatible text reader.");

        if (bytes.size() % 2)
            throw ObjParseError("Truncated UTF-16 text.");

        const bool little = static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[0]) == 0xff;
        auto unit = [&](std::size_t i) {
            const auto a = static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[i]), b = static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[i + 1]);

            return unsigned(little ? (a | (b << 8)) : ((a << 8) | b));
        };
        text.clear();

        for (std::size_t i = 2; i < bytes.size(); i += 2) {
            unsigned c = unit(i);

            if (c >= 0xd800 && c <= 0xdbff) {
                if (i + 3 >= bytes.size())
                    throw ObjParseError("Truncated UTF-16 surrogate pair.");

                const auto low = unit(i + 2);

                if (low < 0xdc00 || low > 0xdfff)
                    throw ObjParseError("Invalid UTF-16 surrogate pair.");
                c = 0x10000 + ((c - 0xd800) << 10) + (low - 0xdc00);
                i += 2;
            } else if (c >= 0xdc00 && c <= 0xdfff)
                throw ObjParseError("Unpaired UTF-16 surrogate.");

            if (c < 0x80)
                text += char(c);
            else if (c < 0x800) {
                text += char(0xc0 | (c >> 6));
                text += char(0x80 | (c & 63));
            } else if (c < 0x10000) {
                text += char(0xe0 | (c >> 12));
                text += char(0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63));
                text += char(0x80 | (c & 63));
            } else {
                text += char(0xf0 | (c >> 18));
                text += char(0x80 | ((c >> 12) & 63));
                text += char(0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63));
                text += char(0x80 | (c & 63));
            }
        }
        objWarning(warnings, "Decoded UTF-16 BOM text as UTF-8.");
    }

    if (text.compare(0, 3, "\xEF\xBB\xBF") == 0)
        text.erase(0, 3);

    if (text.find('\0') != std::string::npos)
        throw ObjParseError("NUL byte in OBJ text; unsupported encoding or binary file.");

    std::string lines;

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < text.size(); ++i) {
        if (text[i] == '\r') {
            lines += '\n';

            if (i + 1 < text.size() && text[i + 1] == '\n')
                ++i;
        } else
            lines += text[i];
    }

    return lines;
}

Model parseObj(const std::string& bytes, const std::string& name, const LoadOptions& options, bool compatible,
               std::vector<std::string>& warnings) {
    std::istringstream input(objText(bytes, compatible, warnings));
    std::vector<glm::vec3> positions, normals;
    std::vector<glm::vec2> uvs;
    std::vector<GlColor> colors;
    std::vector<ObjFace> faces;
    bool hasColors = false;
    std::string physical, line, group = "face";
    std::size_t lineNumber = 0, start = 0, batch = 0;

    while (std::getline(input, physical)) {
        ++lineNumber;

        if (line.empty())
            start = lineNumber;
        physical = physical.substr(0, physical.find('#'));

        const auto end = physical.find_last_not_of(" \t");
        const bool continued = end != std::string::npos && physical[end] == '\\';

        line += continued ? physical.substr(0, end) : physical;

        if (continued) {
            line += ' ';
            continue;
        }

        std::istringstream row(line);

        row.imbue(std::locale::classic());

        std::string kind;

        row >> kind;

        try {
            if (kind == "v") {
                const auto values = objNumbers(row);

                if (values.size() != 3 && values.size() != 4 && values.size() != 6)
                    throw ObjParseError("Expected v x y z [w] or v x y z r g b.");

                glm::vec3 p(values[0], values[1], values[2]);

                if (values.size() == 4) {
                    if (values[3] == 0)
                        throw ObjParseError("Homogeneous vertex has zero w.");
                    p /= values[3];
                }

                if (!finiteVector(p))
                    throw ObjParseError("Vertex overflows after division by w.");
                positions.push_back(p);
                colors.push_back(values.size() == 6 ? GlColor{values[3], values[4], values[5]} : GlColor{});
                hasColors = hasColors || values.size() == 6;
            } else if (kind == "vt") {
                const auto values = objNumbers(row);

                if (values.empty() || values.size() > 3 || (values.size() == 3 && values[2] != 0))
                    throw ObjParseError("Expected vt u [v [0]]; volume texture coordinates are unsupported.");
                uvs.push_back({values[0], values.size() > 1 ? values[1] : 0});
            } else if (kind == "vn") {
                const auto values = objNumbers(row);

                if (values.size() != 3)
                    throw ObjParseError("Expected vn x y z.");

                const glm::dvec3 normal(values[0], values[1], values[2]);

                if (glm::length(normal) == 0)
                    throw ObjParseError("Zero OBJ normal.");
                normals.push_back(glm::vec3(glm::normalize(normal)));
            } else if (kind == "f") {
                ObjFace face;

                face.positions = positions.size();
                face.uvs = uvs.size();
                face.normals = normals.size();
                face.line = start;
                face.batch = batch;
                face.name = group;

                std::string token;

                while (row >> token)
                    face.corners.push_back(objCorner(token));

                if (face.corners.size() < 3)
                    throw ObjParseError("Face has fewer than three corners.");
                faces.push_back(std::move(face));
            } else if (kind == "o" || kind == "g") {
                std::getline(row, group);

                const auto first = group.find_first_not_of(" \t");

                group = first == std::string::npos ? "face" : group.substr(first);
                ++batch;
            } else if (kind == "mtllib" || kind == "usemtl") {
                ++batch;
                objWarning(warnings,
                           "MTL materials are not loaded; set LoadOptions.texturePath or a Scene material explicitly.");
            } else if (kind == "s") {
                ++batch;

                std::string smoothing;

                row >> smoothing;

                if (smoothing != "off" && smoothing != "0")
                    objWarning(
                        warnings,
                        "Smoothing groups are not interpolated; supplied vn values are preserved and missing normals are generated per face.");
            } else if (!kind.empty())
                throw ObjParseError("Unsupported OBJ record: " + kind);
        } catch (const ObjParseError& e) {
            throw ObjParseError("line " + std::to_string(start) + ": " + e.what());
        }
        line.clear();
    }

    if (!line.empty())
        throw ObjParseError("line " + std::to_string(start) + ": unterminated line continuation.");

    Model model;

    model.shape = GLShape::Custom;
    model.name = name;

    Model segment;
    std::size_t activeBatch = 0;
    auto flush = [&] {
        if (options.mergeCoplanarFaces && !hasColors)
            mergeCoplanar(segment);

        for (auto& face : segment.faces)
            model.faces.push_back(std::move(face));
        segment.faces.clear();
    };

    for (auto& face : faces) {
        try {
            if (face.batch != activeBatch) {
                flush();
                activeBatch = face.batch;
            }

            if (compatible) {
                const auto old = face.corners.size();

                face.corners.erase(std::unique(face.corners.begin(), face.corners.end()), face.corners.end());

                if (face.corners.size() > 1 && face.corners.front() == face.corners.back())
                    face.corners.pop_back();

                if (face.corners.size() != old)
                    objWarning(warnings,
                               "Removed repeated identical OBJ corners at line " + std::to_string(face.line) + ".");
            }

            Mesh mesh;

            mesh.name = face.name + "_" + std::to_string(face.line);

            std::size_t uvCount = 0;
            bool forward = false;

            for (const auto& corner : face.corners) {
                const auto p = objResolve(corner.position, face.positions, positions.size(), compatible);

                mesh.localVertices.push_back(positions[p]);

                if (hasColors)
                    mesh.vertexColors.push_back(colors[p]);
                forward = forward ||
                          (corner.position > 0 && static_cast<unsigned long long>(corner.position) > face.positions);

                glm::vec2 uv(0);

                if (corner.uv) {
                    uv = uvs[objResolve(corner.uv, face.uvs, uvs.size(), compatible)];
                    ++uvCount;
                    forward = forward || (corner.uv > 0 && static_cast<unsigned long long>(corner.uv) > face.uvs);
                }
                mesh.texcoords.push_back(uv);
            }
            // Normalize only the triangulation workspace; retain original coordinates.
            if (mesh.localVertices.size() < 3)
                throw ObjParseError("Face has fewer than three distinct corners.");

            glm::dvec3 low(mesh.localVertices[0]), high(low);

            for (const auto& p : mesh.localVertices) {
                low = glm::min(low, glm::dvec3(p));
                high = glm::max(high, glm::dvec3(p));
            }

            const auto size = high - low;
            const double scale = std::max({size.x, size.y, size.z});

            if (scale == 0)
                throw ObjParseError("Degenerate polygon.");

            Mesh workspace;

            for (const auto& p : mesh.localVertices)
                workspace.localVertices.push_back(glm::vec3((glm::dvec3(p) - low) / scale));

            if (workspace.localVertices.size() > 3) {
                glm::dvec3 plane(0);
                const auto count = workspace.localVertices.size();

                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
                    const auto a = glm::dvec3(workspace.localVertices[i]);
                    const auto b = glm::dvec3(workspace.localVertices[(i + 1) % count]);

                    plane += glm::cross(a, b);
                }

                if (glm::length(plane) < 1e-12)
                    throw ObjParseError("Degenerate polygon plane.");
                plane = glm::normalize(plane);

                const auto absolute = glm::abs(plane);
                const int axis =
                    absolute.x > absolute.y ? (absolute.x > absolute.z ? 0 : 2) : (absolute.y > absolute.z ? 1 : 2);
                std::vector<glm::dvec2> projected;

                for (const auto& p : workspace.localVertices) {
                    if (std::abs(glm::dot(plane, glm::dvec3(p - workspace.localVertices[0]))) > 1e-5)
                        throw ObjParseError("Non-planar OBJ polygon; export triangulated faces.");
                    projected.push_back(axis == 0   ? glm::dvec2(p.y, p.z)
                                        : axis == 1 ? glm::dvec2(p.x, p.z)
                                                    : glm::dvec2(p.x, p.y));
                }

                auto cross = [](glm::dvec2 a, glm::dvec2 b, glm::dvec2 c) {
                    return (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - a.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - a.x);
                };

                auto on = [](glm::dvec2 a, glm::dvec2 b, glm::dvec2 p) {
                    return p.x >= std::min(a.x, b.x) - 1e-14 && p.x <= std::max(a.x, b.x) + 1e-14 &&
                           p.y >= std::min(a.y, b.y) - 1e-14 && p.y <= std::max(a.y, b.y) + 1e-14;
                };

                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
                    for (std::size_t j = i + 1; j < count; ++j) {
                        if ((i + 1) % count == j || (j + 1) % count == i)
                            continue;

                        const auto a = projected[i], b = projected[(i + 1) % count], c = projected[j],
                                   d = projected[(j + 1) % count];
                        const auto abC = cross(a, b, c), abD = cross(a, b, d), cdA = cross(c, d, a),
                                   cdB = cross(c, d, b);
                        const bool crossing = ((abC > 1e-14 && abD < -1e-14) || (abC < -1e-14 && abD > 1e-14)) &&
                                              ((cdA > 1e-14 && cdB < -1e-14) || (cdA < -1e-14 && cdB > 1e-14));

                        if (crossing || (std::abs(abC) <= 1e-14 && on(a, b, c)) ||
                            (std::abs(abD) <= 1e-14 && on(a, b, d)) || (std::abs(cdA) <= 1e-14 && on(c, d, a)) ||
                            (std::abs(cdB) <= 1e-14 && on(c, d, b)))
                            throw ObjParseError("Self-intersection or repeated corner in OBJ polygon.");
                    }
            }

            try {
                mesh.triangleIndices = triangulate(workspace.localVertices);
            } catch (const std::runtime_error& e) {
                throw ObjParseError(e.what());
            }
            workspace.triangleIndices = mesh.triangleIndices;
            recalculateNormals(workspace);
            mesh.vertexNormals = std::move(workspace.vertexNormals);

            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < face.corners.size(); ++i)
                if (face.corners[i].normal) {
                    const auto value = face.corners[i].normal;

                    mesh.vertexNormals[i] = normals[objResolve(value, face.normals, normals.size(), compatible)];
                    forward = forward || (value > 0 && static_cast<unsigned long long>(value) > face.normals);
                }

            if (forward)
                objWarning(warnings, "Resolved positive forward references at line " + std::to_string(face.line) + ".");

            if (uvCount == 0)
                mesh.texcoords.clear();
            else if (uvCount != face.corners.size())
                objWarning(warnings, "Filled missing UV corners with (0,0) at line " + std::to_string(face.line) + ".");

            const auto& indices = mesh.triangleIndices;

            mesh.normal =
                glm::normalize(glm::cross(workspace.localVertices[indices[1]] - workspace.localVertices[indices[0]],
                                          workspace.localVertices[indices[2]] - workspace.localVertices[indices[0]]));

            if (!validMesh(mesh))
                throw ObjParseError("Invalid or degenerate OBJ mesh.");
            segment.faces.push_back(std::move(mesh));
        } catch (const ObjParseError& e) {
            throw ObjParseError("line " + std::to_string(face.line) + ": " + e.what());
        }
    }
    flush();

    if (options.mergeCoplanarFaces && hasColors)
        objWarning(warnings, "Coplanar merging is skipped to preserve vertex colors.");

    if (model.faces.empty())
        throw ObjParseError("OBJ contains no polygon faces.");

    return model;
}
} // namespace graphics::detail

namespace graphics {
ModelResult AssetLoader::loadObj(const std::filesystem::path& relative, const LoadOptions& options) const {
    ModelResult result;
    const auto utf8 = relative.u8string();
    const std::string name(utf8.begin(), utf8.end());

    try {
        if (!options.texturePath.empty() && !features_.textures)
            throw std::runtime_error("Enable texture mode before specifying texturePath.");

        std::ifstream input(resolve(relative), std::ios::binary);

        if (!input)
            throw std::runtime_error("Cannot open OBJ text.");

        const std::string bytes((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(input)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());

        if (input.bad())
            throw std::runtime_error("OBJ file read failed.");

        Model model;

        try {
            model = detail::parseObj(bytes, name, options, false, result.warnings);
        } catch (const detail::ObjParseError& first) {
            if (!options.allowObjFallback)
                throw;
            result.warnings.clear();

            try {
                model = detail::parseObj(bytes, name, options, true, result.warnings);
            } catch (const detail::ObjParseError& second) {
                throw std::runtime_error(std::string("Standard reader: ") + first.what() +
                                         "; compatible reader: " + second.what());
            }
            result.usedFallback = true;
            detail::objWarning(result.warnings, std::string("Compatible OBJ reader used after: ") + first.what());
        }

        if (!options.texturePath.empty()) {
            auto image = texture(options.texturePath, options.flipTextureRows);

            for (auto& mesh : model.faces) {
                if (mesh.texcoords.empty())
                    throw std::runtime_error("Explicit texture requires UV coordinates on every face.");
                mesh.material.texture = image;
                mesh.material.useTexture = true;
            }
        }

        auto finished = detail::finishLoad(std::move(model), options);

        finished.warnings = std::move(result.warnings);
        finished.usedFallback = result.usedFallback;

        return finished;
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        result.error = name + ": " + e.what();
        std::cerr << "[OBJ load failed] " << result.error << '\n'
                  << "Check the file path and the reported cause first, including texture settings.\n"
                  << "Supported OBJ text format (.obj or .txt), one record per line:\n"
                  << "  v x y z       : vertex position\n"
                  << "  vt u [v]      : optional texture coordinate\n"
                  << "  vn x y z      : optional nonzero normal\n"
                  << "  f 1 2 3       : face using 1-based vertex indices\n"
                  << "  Corner forms: v, v/vt, v//vn, v/vt/vn; negative relative indices are allowed.\n"
                  << "Minimal triangle example:\n"
                  << "  v 0 0 0\n  v 1 0 0\n  v 0 1 0\n  f 1 2 3\n"
                  << "If parsing still fails, inspect the model's source format and write a parser for it.\n"
                  << "Fill graphics::Mesh.localVertices and triangleIndices, then call\n"
                  << "graphics::recalculateNormals(mesh), add the mesh to graphics::Model.faces,\n"
                  << "and pass that model to Scene::addModel. See framework/docs/OBJ_LOADING.md.\n";

        return result;
    }
}
} // namespace graphics
````

## openGL_3dAssign_24/framework/detail/Patterns.cpp

### 블록 1: before L1, after L1

변경 이유: 실습 폴더 하나로 복사·빌드·실행할 수 있도록 공통 원본의 독립 배포 사본을 포함한다.

**before** (없음)

**after**

````cpp
#include "../Framework.h"
#include "Internal.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace graphics {
std::optional<PathPose> PatternSystem::conveyorCornerPose(double distance, const glm::vec3& start,
                                                          const glm::vec3& pivot, float radius, float endZ) {
    const double straight = double(pivot.x) - start.x, arc = 1.5707963267948966 * radius, last = double(endZ) - pivot.z;

    if (!detail::finiteVector(start) || !detail::finiteVector(pivot) || !std::isfinite(distance) ||
        !std::isfinite(radius) || radius <= 0 || !std::isfinite(endZ) || straight <= 0 || last <= 0 ||
        std::abs(start.z - (pivot.z - radius)) > 1e-4f) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "conveyorCornerPose",
                            "Invalid XZ conveyor geometry.");

        return {};
    }

    double d = std::fmod(distance, straight + arc + last);

    if (d < 0)
        d += straight + arc + last;

    PathPose p;

    if (d < straight) {
        p.position = start + glm::vec3(float(d), 0, 0);
        p.tangent = {1, 0, 0};
    } else if (d < straight + arc) {
        const float a = float((d - straight) / radius);

        p.position = {pivot.x + radius * std::sin(a), start.y, pivot.z - radius * std::cos(a)};
        p.tangent = {std::cos(a), 0, std::sin(a)};
    } else {
        p.position = {pivot.x + radius, start.y, pivot.z + float(d - straight - arc)};
        p.tangent = {0, 0, 1};
    }
    p.yawDegrees = glm::degrees(std::atan2(p.tangent.x, p.tangent.z));

    return p;
}

bool Bounds3::valid() const {
    return detail::finiteVector(minimum) && detail::finiteVector(maximum) && maximum.x > minimum.x &&
           maximum.y > minimum.y && maximum.z > minimum.z;
}

bool Bounds3::contains(const glm::vec3& p, const glm::vec3& margin) const {
    return valid() && detail::finiteVector(p) && detail::finiteVector(margin) && margin.x >= 0 && margin.y >= 0 &&
           margin.z >= 0 && p.x >= minimum.x + margin.x && p.x <= maximum.x - margin.x && p.y >= minimum.y + margin.y &&
           p.y <= maximum.y - margin.y && p.z >= minimum.z + margin.z && p.z <= maximum.z - margin.z;
}

bool Bounds3::overlaps(const Bounds3& b) const {
    return valid() && b.valid() && minimum.x < b.maximum.x && maximum.x > b.minimum.x && minimum.y < b.maximum.y &&
           maximum.y > b.minimum.y && minimum.z < b.maximum.z && maximum.z > b.minimum.z;
}

bool DistancePath::setPoints(const std::vector<glm::vec3>& points, bool closed) {
    if (points.size() < 2)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "DistancePath::setPoints",
                                   "Need at least two points.");

    auto candidate = points;

    for (const auto& p : candidate)
        if (!detail::finiteVector(p))
            return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "DistancePath::setPoints",
                                       "Path contains NaN/Inf.");

    if (closed && glm::length(glm::dvec3(candidate.front()) - glm::dvec3(candidate.back())) > 1e-10)
        candidate.push_back(candidate.front());

    std::vector<double> distances{0};

    for (std::size_t i = 1; i < candidate.size(); ++i) {
        const double segment = glm::length(glm::dvec3(candidate[i]) - glm::dvec3(candidate[i - 1]));

        if (!std::isfinite(segment) || segment <= 1e-10 || !std::isfinite(distances.back() + segment))
            return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "DistancePath::setPoints",
                                       "Zero-length, repeated or overflowing path segment.");
        distances.push_back(distances.back() + segment);
    }
    points_ = std::move(candidate);
    distances_ = std::move(distances);

    return true;
}

std::optional<PathPose> DistancePath::sample(double distance, Playback playback) const {
    const double total = length();

    if (total <= 0 || !std::isfinite(distance)) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "DistancePath::sample",
                            "Configure a nonempty path and finite distance.");

        return {};
    }

    double sign = 1;

    if (playback == Playback::Once)
        distance = std::clamp(distance, 0.0, total);
    else if (playback == Playback::Loop) {
        distance = std::fmod(distance, total);

        if (distance < 0)
            distance += total;
    } else if (playback == Playback::PingPong) {
        distance = std::fmod(distance, 2 * total);

        if (distance < 0)
            distance += 2 * total;

        if (distance > total) {
            distance = 2 * total - distance;
            sign = -1;
        }
    } else {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "DistancePath::sample",
                            "Invalid Playback value.");

        return {};
    }

    const auto end = std::upper_bound(distances_.begin(), distances_.end(), distance);
    const std::size_t i = end == distances_.end() ? distances_.size() - 1 : std::size_t(end - distances_.begin());
    const float weight = float((distance - distances_[i - 1]) / (distances_[i] - distances_[i - 1]));
    PathPose pose;

    pose.position = glm::mix(points_[i - 1], points_[i], weight);
    pose.tangent = glm::vec3(glm::normalize(glm::dvec3(points_[i]) - glm::dvec3(points_[i - 1])) * sign);
    pose.yawDegrees = glm::degrees(std::atan2(pose.tangent.x, pose.tangent.z));

    return pose;
}

bool AnimationClock::advance(double dt) {
    if (!std::isfinite(dt) || dt < 0 || !std::isfinite(seconds) || seconds < 0 || !std::isfinite(seconds + dt))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "AnimationClock::advance",
                                   "Time must be finite, nonnegative and within range.");

    if (playing)
        seconds += dt;

    return true;
}

namespace detail {
bool rigidRoom(const glm::mat4& matrix) {
    const auto r = glm::mat3(matrix), identity = glm::transpose(r) * r;

    return TransformSystem::validAffine(matrix) && std::abs(glm::determinant(r) - 1) < .001f &&
           glm::length(identity[0] - glm::vec3(1, 0, 0)) < .001f &&
           glm::length(identity[1] - glm::vec3(0, 1, 0)) < .001f &&
           glm::length(identity[2] - glm::vec3(0, 0, 1)) < .001f;
}

bool horizontalOverlap(const CharacterBody& b, const glm::vec3& feet, const Bounds3& box) {
    return feet.x + b.halfWidth.x > box.minimum.x && feet.x - b.halfWidth.x < box.maximum.x &&
           feet.z + b.halfWidth.y > box.minimum.z && feet.z - b.halfWidth.y < box.maximum.z;
}
}

bool CollisionSystem::stepRoomBody(RoomBody& body, const Bounds3& room, const glm::mat4& roomWorld, float dt,
                                   bool floorOpen, bool elastic, const glm::vec3& gravity,
                                   const glm::vec3& angularVelocity) {
    if (!room.valid() || !detail::rigidRoom(roomWorld) || !detail::finiteVector(gravity) ||
        !detail::finiteVector(angularVelocity) || !detail::finiteVector(body.localPosition) ||
        !detail::finiteVector(body.localVelocity) || !detail::positiveLengths(body.halfExtent) ||
        !detail::finiteVector(body.worldPosition) || !detail::finiteVector(body.worldVelocity) || !std::isfinite(dt) ||
        dt < 0 || dt > .25f)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "CollisionSystem::stepRoomBody",
            "Need a rigid room transform, finite body state, positive half extents and dt in [0,.25].");

    const auto low = room.minimum + body.halfExtent, high = room.maximum - body.halfExtent;

    if (low.x >= high.x || low.y >= high.y || low.z >= high.z)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "CollisionSystem::stepRoomBody",
                                   "Body does not fit inside the room.");

    auto next = body;
    const int steps = std::max(1, int(std::ceil(dt * 120)));
    const float h = dt / steps;
    const auto rotation = glm::mat3(roomWorld);
    const auto localGravity = glm::transpose(rotation) * gravity;

    for (int s = 0; s < steps; ++s) {
        if (next.released) {
            next.worldVelocity += gravity * h;
            next.worldPosition += next.worldVelocity * h;
            continue;
        }

        if (!elastic)
            next.localVelocity += localGravity * h;
        next.localPosition += next.localVelocity * h;

        if (floorOpen && next.localPosition.y < low.y) {
            next.released = true;
            next.worldPosition = glm::vec3(roomWorld * glm::vec4(next.localPosition, 1));
            next.worldVelocity = rotation * next.localVelocity +
                                 glm::cross(angularVelocity, next.worldPosition - glm::vec3(roomWorld[3]));
            continue;
        }

        for (int axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis) {
            if (elastic && !(floorOpen && axis == 1)) {
                const double width = double(high[axis]) - low[axis];
                const double p = double(next.localPosition[axis]) - low[axis];
                double folded = std::fmod(p, 2 * width);

                if (folded < 0)
                    folded += 2 * width;

                const bool reflected = folded > width;

                next.localPosition[axis] = float(low[axis] + (reflected ? 2 * width - folded : folded));

                if (reflected)
                    next.localVelocity[axis] = -next.localVelocity[axis];

                if (next.localPosition[axis] <= low[axis])
                    next.localVelocity[axis] = std::abs(next.localVelocity[axis]);

                if (next.localPosition[axis] >= high[axis])
                    next.localVelocity[axis] = -std::abs(next.localVelocity[axis]);
            } else {
                if (next.localPosition[axis] < low[axis] && !(floorOpen && axis == 1)) {
                    next.localPosition[axis] = low[axis];
                    next.localVelocity[axis] =
                        elastic ? std::abs(next.localVelocity[axis]) : std::max(0.0f, next.localVelocity[axis]);
                }

                if (next.localPosition[axis] > high[axis]) {
                    next.localPosition[axis] = high[axis];
                    next.localVelocity[axis] =
                        elastic ? -std::abs(next.localVelocity[axis]) : std::min(0.0f, next.localVelocity[axis]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (!detail::finiteVector(next.localPosition) || !detail::finiteVector(next.localVelocity) ||
        !detail::finiteVector(next.worldPosition) || !detail::finiteVector(next.worldVelocity))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "CollisionSystem::stepRoomBody",
                                   "Simulation overflow; original state was preserved.");
    body = next;

    return true;
}

bool CollisionSystem::jump(CharacterBody& body, float speed) {
    if (!std::isfinite(speed) || speed <= 0)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "CollisionSystem::jump",
                                   "Jump speed must be positive and finite.");

    if (!body.grounded)
        return false; // Normal input rejection, not an API error.
    body.verticalSpeed = speed;
    body.grounded = false;

    return true;
}

std::optional<CharacterStep> CollisionSystem::stepCharacter(CharacterBody& body, const Bounds3& stage,
                                                            const std::vector<Bounds3>& obstacles, float dt,
                                                            float gravity) {
    if (!stage.valid() || !detail::finiteVector(body.feet) || !detail::finiteVector(body.direction) ||
        !std::isfinite(body.speed) || body.speed < 0 || !std::isfinite(body.height) || body.height <= 0 ||
        !std::isfinite(body.halfWidth.x) || !std::isfinite(body.halfWidth.y) || body.halfWidth.x <= 0 ||
        body.halfWidth.y <= 0 || !std::isfinite(body.verticalSpeed) || !std::isfinite(body.walkDistance) ||
        !std::isfinite(dt) || dt < 0 || dt > .25f || !std::isfinite(gravity) || gravity <= 0) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "CollisionSystem::stepCharacter",
                            "Invalid bounds, body dimensions, speed, gravity or dt.");

        return {};
    }

    if (stage.maximum.x - stage.minimum.x <= 2 * body.halfWidth.x ||
        stage.maximum.z - stage.minimum.z <= 2 * body.halfWidth.y) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "CollisionSystem::stepCharacter",
                            "Character does not fit on the stage.");

        return {};
    }

    float spacing = std::min(body.halfWidth.x, body.halfWidth.y) * .5f;

    for (const auto& box : obstacles) {
        if (!box.valid()) {
            Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "CollisionSystem::stepCharacter",
                                "Invalid obstacle bounds.");

            return {};
        }
        spacing = std::min(spacing, std::min(box.maximum.x - box.minimum.x, box.maximum.z - box.minimum.z) * .5f);
    }

    const double count =
        std::ceil(std::max(double(dt) * 120, double(body.speed) * dt / std::max(double(spacing), 1e-9)));

    if (count > 4096) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "CollisionSystem::stepCharacter",
                            "Motion exceeds the substep budget; reduce speed or dt.");

        return {};
    }

    auto next = body;
    CharacterStep event;

    next.direction.y = 0;

    const double directionLength = glm::length(glm::dvec3(next.direction));

    next.direction = directionLength > 1e-10 ? glm::vec3(glm::dvec3(next.direction) / directionLength) : glm::vec3(0);

    const int steps = std::max(1, int(count));
    const float h = dt / steps;

    for (int i = 0; i < steps; ++i) {
        const auto previous = next.feet;
        auto candidate = previous + next.direction * (next.speed * h);
        bool blocked =
            candidate.x - next.halfWidth.x < stage.minimum.x || candidate.x + next.halfWidth.x > stage.maximum.x ||
            candidate.z - next.halfWidth.y < stage.minimum.z || candidate.z + next.halfWidth.y > stage.maximum.z;

        for (const auto& box : obstacles)
            if (previous.y < box.maximum.y - 1e-4f && previous.y + next.height > box.minimum.y + 1e-4f &&
                detail::horizontalOverlap(next, candidate, box))
                blocked = true;

        if (blocked) {
            next.direction = -next.direction;
            candidate = previous;
            event.blocked = event.turned = true;
        }
        next.feet = candidate;
        next.walkDistance += glm::length(glm::dvec2(candidate.x - previous.x, candidate.z - previous.z));

        bool supported = std::abs(next.feet.y - stage.minimum.y) < 1e-4f;

        for (const auto& box : obstacles)
            if (detail::horizontalOverlap(next, next.feet, box) && std::abs(next.feet.y - box.maximum.y) < 1e-4f)
                supported = true;

        if (next.grounded && !supported)
            next.grounded = false;

        if (!next.grounded) {
            const float oldY = next.feet.y;

            next.verticalSpeed -= gravity * h;

            float newY = oldY + next.verticalSpeed * h;
            float landing = stage.minimum.y;

            for (const auto& box : obstacles)
                if (detail::horizontalOverlap(next, next.feet, box)) {
                    if (next.verticalSpeed <= 0 && oldY >= box.maximum.y - 1e-4f && newY <= box.maximum.y)
                        landing = std::max(landing, box.maximum.y);

                    if (next.verticalSpeed > 0 && oldY + next.height <= box.minimum.y &&
                        newY + next.height >= box.minimum.y) {
                        newY = box.minimum.y - next.height;
                        next.verticalSpeed = 0;
                    }
                }

            if (next.verticalSpeed <= 0 && newY <= landing && oldY >= landing - 1e-4f) {
                newY = landing;
                next.verticalSpeed = 0;
                next.grounded = true;
                event.landed = true;
            }
            next.feet.y = newY;
        }
    }

    if (!detail::finiteVector(next.feet) || !std::isfinite(next.walkDistance) || !std::isfinite(next.verticalSpeed)) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "CollisionSystem::stepCharacter",
                            "Simulation overflow; original state was preserved.");

        return {};
    }
    body = next;

    return event;
}

std::optional<Bounds3> CollisionSystem::randomFreeBox(const Bounds3& area, const glm::vec3& size,
                                                      const std::vector<Bounds3>& occupied, std::mt19937& random,
                                                      unsigned attempts) {
    if (!area.valid() || !detail::positiveLengths(size) || attempts == 0 || attempts > 100000 ||
        size.x > area.maximum.x - area.minimum.x || size.y > area.maximum.y - area.minimum.y ||
        size.z > area.maximum.z - area.minimum.z) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "CollisionSystem::randomFreeBox",
                            "Box must fit in the area; attempts must be in [1,100000].");

        return {};
    }

    for (const auto& box : occupied)
        if (!box.valid()) {
            Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "CollisionSystem::randomFreeBox",
                                "Invalid occupied bounds.");

            return {};
        }

    for (unsigned i = 0; i < attempts; ++i) {
        Bounds3 box;

        for (int axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
            box.minimum[axis] =
                std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(area.minimum[axis], area.maximum[axis] - size[axis])(random);
        box.maximum = box.minimum + size;

        if (std::none_of(occupied.begin(), occupied.end(), [&](const Bounds3& other) {
                return box.overlaps(other);
            }))
            return box;
    }
    Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "CollisionSystem::randomFreeBox",
                        "No free placement within the attempt budget.",
                        "Use smaller objects, fewer occupied regions or a larger placement area.");

    return {};
}

std::optional<EntityId> PatternSystem::addBox(Scene& scene, const glm::vec3& size, const glm::vec3& position,
                                              GlColor color, std::optional<EntityId> parent) {
    if (!detail::positiveLengths(size) || !detail::finiteVector(position) || !detail::validColor(color) ||
        (parent && !scene.getComponent(*parent))) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "PatternSystem::addBox",
                            "Need positive dimensions, finite position/color and an existing parent.");

        return {};
    }

    auto model = DiagramSystem::makePolyhedron(GLShape::Cube, size);

    for (auto& face : model.faces)
        face.color = color;

    Transform3D transform;

    transform.basis = position;

    const auto entity = scene.addModel(model, transform, PivotMode::Preserve);

    if (!entity || !scene.setParent(*entity, parent))
        return {};

    return entity;
}

std::optional<EntityId> PatternSystem::addPolygon(Scene& scene, const std::vector<glm::vec3>& points, GlColor color,
                                                  std::optional<EntityId> parent) {
    if (points.size() < 3 || !detail::validColor(color) || (parent && !scene.getComponent(*parent))) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "PatternSystem::addPolygon",
                            "Need a convex polygon (>=3 points), valid color and parent.");

        return {};
    }

    Mesh face;

    face.localVertices = points;
    face.color = color;

    for (std::size_t i = 1; i + 1 < points.size(); ++i)
        face.triangleIndices.insert(face.triangleIndices.end(), {0, std::uint32_t(i), std::uint32_t(i + 1)});
    recalculateNormals(face);

    Model model;

    model.faces.push_back(face);

    const auto entity = scene.addModel(model, Transform3D{}, PivotMode::Preserve);

    if (!entity || !scene.setParent(*entity, parent))
        return {};

    return entity;
}

std::optional<EntityId> PatternSystem::addRoom(Scene& scene, const Bounds3& bounds, bool frontOpen) {
    if (!bounds.valid()) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "PatternSystem::addRoom",
                            "Room bounds must have positive finite extents.");

        return {};
    }

    auto model = DiagramSystem::makePolyhedron(GLShape::Cube, bounds.maximum - bounds.minimum);

    for (auto& face : model.faces) {
        face.cull = CullMode::Front;
        recalculateNormals(face);

        for (auto& normal : face.vertexNormals)
            normal = -normal;
    }
    model.faces[0].visible = !frontOpen;

    Transform3D transform;

    transform.basis = (bounds.minimum + bounds.maximum) * .5f;

    return scene.addModel(model, transform, PivotMode::Preserve);
}

std::optional<EntityId> PatternSystem::addJoint(Scene& scene, EntityId parent, const glm::vec3& anchor) {
    if (!scene.getComponent(parent) || !detail::finiteVector(anchor)) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "PatternSystem::addJoint",
                            "Missing parent or non-finite anchor.");

        return {};
    }

    Transform3D transform;

    transform.basis = anchor;

    const auto joint = scene.addGroup(transform);

    if (!joint || !scene.setParent(*joint, parent))
        return {};

    return joint;
}

bool PatternSystem::rotateJoint(Scene& scene, EntityId joint, const glm::vec3& axis, float degrees) {
    const auto* component = scene.getComponent(joint);
    const auto rotation = TransformSystem::rotation({{0, 0, 0}, axis}, degrees);

    if (!component || !rotation)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "PatternSystem::rotateJoint",
                                   "Missing joint or invalid rotation.");

    auto transform = component->transform;

    transform.rotation = glm::mat3(*rotation);

    return scene.setTransform(joint, transform);
}

bool PatternSystem::follow(Scene& scene, EntityId entity, const DistancePath& path, double distance,
                           const glm::vec3& offset, bool orient) {
    const auto pose = path.sample(distance);
    const auto* component = scene.getComponent(entity);

    if (!pose || !component || !detail::finiteVector(offset))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "PatternSystem::follow",
                                   "Invalid path sample, entity or offset.");

    auto transform = component->transform;

    transform.basis = pose->position + offset;

    if (orient)
        transform.rotation = glm::mat3(glm::rotate(glm::mat4(1), glm::radians(pose->yawDegrees), glm::vec3(0, 1, 0)));

    return scene.setTransform(entity, transform);
}

bool PatternSystem::addNumber(Scene& scene, unsigned digit, const glm::vec3& position, float height, GlColor color,
                              std::optional<EntityId> parent) {
    if (digit > 9 || !detail::finiteVector(position) || !std::isfinite(height) || height <= 0 ||
        !detail::validColor(color) || (parent && !scene.getComponent(*parent)))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "PatternSystem::addNumber",
                                   "Need digit 0-9, positive height, finite values and a valid parent.");
    constexpr unsigned masks[10] = {0x3f, 0x06, 0x5b, 0x4f, 0x66, 0x6d, 0x7d, 0x07, 0x7f, 0x6f};

    const glm::vec2 endpoints[7][2] = {{{0, 1}, {.5f, 1}},    {{.5f, 1}, {.5f, .5f}}, {{.5f, .5f}, {.5f, 0}},
                                       {{0, 0}, {.5f, 0}},    {{0, .5f}, {0, 0}},     {{0, 1}, {0, .5f}},
                                       {{0, .5f}, {.5f, .5f}}};

    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 7; ++i)
        if (masks[digit] & (1u << i)) {
            const auto a = position + glm::vec3(endpoints[i][0] * height, 0),
                       b = position + glm::vec3(endpoints[i][1] * height, 0);

            if (!scene.addLine(a, b, color, parent))
                return false;
        }

    return true;
}

bool PatternSystem::rotateFace(Scene& scene, EntityId entity, std::size_t face, const FaceRotationConfig& config) {
    const auto* component = scene.getComponent(entity);
    const auto* mesh = scene.getMesh(entity, face);
    if (!component || !mesh || mesh->localVertices.size() < 3 || !std::isfinite(config.degrees))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "rotateFace",
                                   "Need a valid polygon face and finite angle.");
    const auto srt = detail::faceSrtMatrix(*mesh);
    auto point = [&](const glm::vec3& vertex) { return glm::vec3(srt * glm::vec4(vertex, 1)); };
    AxisLine axis;
    switch (config.kind) {
    case FaceRotationKind::EdgeHinge:
        if (config.edge >= mesh->localVertices.size()) return false;
        axis.point = point(mesh->localVertices[config.edge]);
        axis.direction = point(mesh->localVertices[(config.edge + 1) % mesh->localVertices.size()]) - axis.point;
        break;
    case FaceRotationKind::SelfSpin:
        for (const auto& vertex : mesh->localVertices) axis.point += point(vertex);
        axis.point /= float(mesh->localVertices.size());
        axis.direction = config.axis;
        break;
    case FaceRotationKind::ModelOrbit: {
        const auto bounds = detail::bounds(component->polyhedron);
        axis.point = bounds.first*.5f + bounds.second*.5f;
        axis.direction = config.axis;
        break;
    }
    default: return false;
    }
    const auto matrix = TransformSystem::rotation(axis, config.degrees);
    return matrix && scene.setFaceLocalMatrix(entity, face, *matrix, FaceAnimationSpace::Model);
}

bool PatternSystem::foldFace(Scene& scene, EntityId entity, std::size_t face, const AxisLine& hinge, float degrees) {
    const auto matrix = TransformSystem::rotation(hinge, degrees);

    return matrix && scene.setFaceLocalMatrix(entity, face, *matrix);
}

bool PatternSystem::openFace(Scene& scene, EntityId entity, std::size_t face, float progress,
                             const glm::vec3& displacement, const glm::vec3& topPivot, bool scaleOpen) {
    if (!std::isfinite(progress) || progress < 0 || progress > 1 || !detail::finiteVector(displacement) ||
        !detail::finiteVector(topPivot))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "PatternSystem::openFace",
                                   "Need progress in [0,1] and finite vectors.");

    if (scaleOpen) {
        // Fully open faces are hidden; retain a nonsingular matrix for normals/picking.
        const auto scale = TransformSystem::scaling({1, std::max(1e-4f, 1 - progress), 1}, topPivot);

        return scale && scene.setFaceLocalMatrix(entity, face, *scale) &&
               scene.setFaceVisible(entity, face, progress < 1);
    }

    return scene.setFaceLocalMatrix(entity, face, glm::translate(glm::mat4(1), displacement * progress)) &&
           scene.setFaceVisible(entity, face, true);
}

std::optional<std::size_t> PatternSystem::cameraFacingWall(const Scene& scene, EntityId room, const Camera& camera) {
    const auto* component = scene.getComponent(room);
    const auto world = scene.worldMatrix(room);

    if (!component || component->polyhedron.faces.size() != 6 || !world || !CameraSystem::validCamera(camera) ||
        std::abs(glm::determinant(glm::mat3(*world))) < 1e-8f) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "cameraFacingWall",
                            "Need a six-face room, invertible world transform and valid camera.");

        return {};
    }

    const auto view = glm::normalize(camera.target - camera.position);
    const auto normals = glm::transpose(glm::inverse(glm::mat3(*world)));
    float best = 0;
    std::optional<std::size_t> selected;

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        const auto& vertices = component->polyhedron.faces[i].localVertices;

        if (vertices.size() < 3)
            return {};

        const auto n = glm::normalize(normals * glm::cross(vertices[1] - vertices[0], vertices[2] - vertices[0]));
        const float score = glm::dot(n, view);

        if (score > best + 1e-6f) {
            best = score;
            selected = i;
        }
    }

    return selected; // Select the far interior wall visible along the viewing direction.
}

bool PatternSystem::openRoomWall(Scene& scene, EntityId room, std::size_t face, float progress) {
    const auto* mesh = scene.getMesh(room, face);

    if (!mesh || face >= 4 || mesh->localVertices.empty())
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "openRoomWall",
                                   "Select one of the four side walls of addRoom().");

    if (!std::isfinite(progress) || progress < 0 || progress > 1)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "openRoomWall",
                                   "Need progress in [0,1].");

    glm::vec3 pivot(0);

    for (const auto& vertex : mesh->localVertices)
        pivot += vertex;
    pivot /= float(mesh->localVertices.size());
    // Fully open faces are hidden; retain a nonsingular matrix for normals/picking.
    const float factor = std::max(1e-3f, 1 - progress);
    const auto scale = TransformSystem::scaling(glm::vec3(factor), pivot);

    return scale && scene.setFaceLocalMatrix(room, face, *scale) && scene.setFaceVisible(room, face, progress < 1);
}

std::vector<glm::ivec3> PatternSystem::snakeCells(const glm::ivec3& cells) {
    std::vector<glm::ivec3> result;

    if (cells.x <= 0 || cells.y != 1 || cells.z <= 0 || std::uint64_t(cells.x) * cells.z > 1000000) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "PatternSystem::snakeCells",
                            "Need an XZ grid with y=1 and at most 1,000,000 cells.");

        return result;
    }

    for (int z = 0; z < cells.z; ++z)
        for (int x = 0; x < cells.x; ++x)
            result.push_back({z % 2 ? cells.x - 1 - x : x, 0, z});

    return result;
}

bool PatternSystem::aligned(float first, float second, float tolerance) {
    if (!std::isfinite(first) || !std::isfinite(second) || !std::isfinite(tolerance) || tolerance < 0)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "PatternSystem::aligned",
                                   "Need finite heights and nonnegative tolerance.");

    return std::abs(double(first) - second) <= tolerance;
}

glm::vec3 PatternSystem::snap(const glm::vec3& point, float spacing) {
    if (!detail::finiteVector(point) || !std::isfinite(spacing) || spacing <= 0) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "PatternSystem::snap",
                            "Need finite point and positive spacing.");

        return point;
    }

    const auto result = glm::vec3(glm::round(glm::dvec3(point) / double(spacing)) * double(spacing));

    if (!detail::finiteVector(result)) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "PatternSystem::snap", "Snap overflow.");

        return point;
    }

    return result;
}

std::optional<glm::vec3> PatternSystem::screenOnPlane(const Camera& camera, double x, double y,
                                                      const PickViewport& viewport, const glm::vec3& planePoint,
                                                      const glm::vec3& normal) {
    const auto ray = screenRay(camera, x, y, viewport);
    const auto n = detail::motionUnitVector(normal);

    if (!ray || !n || !detail::finiteVector(planePoint)) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Input, "PatternSystem::screenOnPlane",
                            "Invalid camera, viewport, pointer or plane.");

        return {};
    }

    const double denominator = glm::dot(glm::dvec3(ray->direction), glm::dvec3(*n));

    if (std::abs(denominator) < 1e-10)
        return {};

    const double t = glm::dot(glm::dvec3(planePoint) - glm::dvec3(ray->origin), glm::dvec3(*n)) / denominator;

    if (t < 0 || t > ray->maxDistance)
        return {};

    return glm::vec3(glm::dvec3(ray->origin) + glm::dvec3(ray->direction) * t);
}

bool PatternSystem::moveCamera(Camera& camera, const glm::vec3& offset) {
    auto next = camera;

    next.position += offset;
    next.target += offset;

    if (!CameraSystem::validCamera(next))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "PatternSystem::moveCamera",
                                   "Camera translation creates an invalid camera.");
    camera = next;

    return true;
}

bool PatternSystem::yawCamera(Camera& camera, float degrees) {
    if (!CameraSystem::validCamera(camera))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "PatternSystem::yawCamera",
                                   "Invalid camera.");

    const auto forward = glm::normalize(camera.target - camera.position),
               right = glm::normalize(glm::cross(forward, camera.up));
    const auto up = glm::normalize(glm::cross(right, forward));
    const auto rotation = TransformSystem::rotation({camera.position, up}, degrees);

    if (!rotation)
        return false;

    auto next = camera;

    next.target = glm::vec3(*rotation * glm::vec4(camera.target, 1));
    next.up = glm::mat3(*rotation) * up;

    if (!CameraSystem::validCamera(next))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "PatternSystem::yawCamera",
                                   "Rotation creates an invalid camera.");
    camera = next;

    return true;
}

bool PatternSystem::orbitCamera(Camera& camera, const AxisLine& axis, float degrees) {
    const auto rotation = TransformSystem::rotation(axis, degrees);

    if (!rotation)
        return false;

    auto next = camera;

    next.position = glm::vec3(*rotation * glm::vec4(camera.position, 1));
    next.target = glm::vec3(*rotation * glm::vec4(camera.target, 1));
    next.up = glm::mat3(*rotation) * camera.up;

    if (!CameraSystem::validCamera(next))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "PatternSystem::orbitCamera",
                                   "Orbit creates an invalid camera.");
    camera = next;

    return true;
}

bool PatternSystem::zoomCamera(Camera& camera, float factor) {
    if (!std::isfinite(factor) || factor <= 0)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "PatternSystem::zoomCamera",
                                   "Zoom factor must be positive and finite.");

    auto next = camera;

    if (next.orthographic)
        next.orthographicHalfExtent *= factor;
    else
        next.position = next.target + (next.position - next.target) * factor;

    if (!CameraSystem::validCamera(next))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "PatternSystem::zoomCamera",
                                   "Zoom creates an invalid camera.");
    camera = next;

    return true;
}

std::vector<RenderPass> PatternSystem::threeViews(const Camera& perspective, int width, int height,
                                                  const RenderOptions& options) {
    if (width < 3 || height < 2 || !CameraSystem::validCamera(perspective)) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Framebuffer, "PatternSystem::threeViews",
                            "Need a valid camera and framebuffer of at least 3x2 pixels.");

        return {};
    }

    const int left = width * 2 / 3, right = width - left, bottom = height / 2;
    RenderPass main;

    main.camera = perspective;
    main.camera.orthographic = false;
    main.options = options;
    main.viewport = {0, 0, left, height};

    RenderPass top = main;

    top.viewport = {left, bottom, right, height - bottom};
    top.camera.orthographic = true;
    top.camera.position = perspective.target + glm::vec3(0, 20, 0);
    top.camera.target = perspective.target;
    top.camera.up = {0, 0, -1};
    top.camera.orthographicHalfExtent = std::max(6.5f, perspective.orthographicHalfExtent);

    RenderPass front = top;

    front.viewport = {left, 0, right, bottom};
    front.camera.position = perspective.target + glm::vec3(0, 0, 20);
    front.camera.up = {0, 1, 0};

    return {main, top, front};
}

std::optional<JointRig> PatternSystem::addWalkingRig(Scene& scene, const GridLayout& grid) {
    if (!grid.valid() || !detail::rigidRoom(grid.frame)) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "PatternSystem::addWalkingRig",
                            "Need a valid grid with a rigid frame.");

        return {};
    }

    JointRig rig;
    const auto root = scene.addGroup();

    if (!root)
        return {};
    rig.root = *root;

    auto point = [&](glm::vec3 ratio) {
        return grid.origin + grid.extent * ratio;
    };

    const auto torso =
        addBox(scene, grid.extent * glm::vec3(.45f, .35f, .7f), point({.5f, .58f, .5f}), {.65f, .65f, .7f}, rig.root);
    const auto head = addJoint(scene, rig.root, point({.5f, .8f, .5f}));

    if (!torso || !head)
        return {};
    rig.head = *head;

    if (!addBox(scene, grid.extent * glm::vec3(.3f, .2f, .6f), {0, grid.extent.y * .1f, 0}, {1, .8f, .5f}, rig.head) ||
        !addBox(scene, grid.extent * glm::vec3(.1f, .05f, .2f), {0, grid.extent.y * .1f, grid.extent.z * .4f},
                {1, .2f, .2f}, rig.head))
        return {};

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        const float x = i == 0 ? .2f : .8f;
        const GlColor color = i == 0 ? GlColor{.2f, .6f, 1} : GlColor{1, .4f, .2f};
        const auto shoulder = addJoint(scene, rig.root, point({x, .72f, .5f})),
                   hip = addJoint(scene, rig.root, point({i == 0 ? .35f : .65f, .4f, .5f}));

        if (!shoulder || !hip)
            return {};
        rig.shoulders[i] = *shoulder;
        rig.hips[i] = *hip;

        if (!addBox(scene, grid.extent * glm::vec3(.15f, .32f, .3f), {0, -grid.extent.y * .16f, 0}, color, *shoulder) ||
            !addBox(scene, grid.extent * glm::vec3(.18f, .4f, .4f), {0, -grid.extent.y * .2f, 0}, color, *hip))
            return {};
    }

    Transform3D transform;

    transform.rotation = glm::mat3(grid.frame);
    transform.basis = glm::vec3(grid.frame[3]);

    if (!scene.setTransform(rig.root, transform))
        return {};

    return rig;
}

bool PatternSystem::poseWalkingRig(Scene& scene, const JointRig& rig, const glm::vec3& feet, float yawDegrees,
                                   double distance, float speed) {
    if (!detail::finiteVector(feet) || !std::isfinite(yawDegrees) || !std::isfinite(distance) ||
        !std::isfinite(speed) || speed < 0)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "PatternSystem::poseWalkingRig",
                                   "Need finite pose values and nonnegative speed.");

    const auto* root = scene.getComponent(rig.root);

    if (!root || !scene.getComponent(rig.head))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "PatternSystem::poseWalkingRig",
                                   "Rig IDs are missing or stale.");

    for (auto id : rig.shoulders)
        if (!scene.getComponent(id))
            return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "PatternSystem::poseWalkingRig",
                                       "Shoulder joint is missing.");

    for (auto id : rig.hips)
        if (!scene.getComponent(id))
            return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "PatternSystem::poseWalkingRig",
                                       "Hip joint is missing.");

    auto transform = root->transform;

    transform.basis = feet;
    transform.rotation = glm::mat3(glm::rotate(glm::mat4(1), glm::radians(yawDegrees), glm::vec3(0, 1, 0)));

    if (!scene.setTransform(rig.root, transform))
        return false;

    const float angle =
        std::min(50.0f, 15 + speed * 12) * float(std::sin(std::remainder(distance, 1.0) * 6.283185307179586));

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        const float sign = i == 0 ? 1.0f : -1.0f;

        if (!rotateJoint(scene, rig.hips[i], {1, 0, 0}, sign * angle) ||
            !rotateJoint(scene, rig.shoulders[i], {1, 0, 0}, -sign * angle))
            return false;
    }

    return true;
}
} // namespace graphics
````

## openGL_3dAssign_24/framework/detail/Renderer.cpp

### 블록 1: before L1, after L1

변경 이유: 실습 폴더 하나로 복사·빌드·실행할 수 있도록 공통 원본의 독립 배포 사본을 포함한다.

**before** (없음)

**after**

````cpp
#include "../Framework.h"
#include "Internal.h"
#include "Shaders.h"
#include "../dependencies/glm/glm/gtc/type_ptr.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <cstring>

namespace graphics {
std::string readTextFile(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    std::ifstream input(path, std::ios::binary);

    if (!input)
        return {};

    std::ostringstream buffer;

    buffer << input.rdbuf();

    auto text = buffer.str();

    if (text.compare(0, 3, "\xEF\xBB\xBF") == 0)
        text.erase(0, 3);

    return text;
}

namespace detail {
GLuint compileShader(GLenum kind, const std::string& sourceText, const std::filesystem::path& sourcePath) {
    Diagnostics::trace(PipelineStage::Shader, "compileShader");

    auto& api = gl();
    const auto shader = api.CreateShader(kind);

    if (!shader) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "glCreateShader", "Shader allocation failed.");

        return 0;
    }

    const char* text = sourceText.c_str();

    api.ShaderSource(shader, 1, &text, nullptr);
    api.CompileShader(shader);

    GLint success = 0;

    api.GetShaderiv(shader, GL_COMPILE_STATUS, &success);

    if (!success) {
        GLint length = 0;

        api.GetShaderiv(shader, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &length);

        std::string log(std::max(length, 1), '\0');

        api.GetShaderInfoLog(shader, GLsizei(log.size()), nullptr, log.data());
        Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, kind == GL_VERTEX_SHADER ? "vertex shader" : "fragment shader",
            "GLSL file=" + sourcePath.u8string() + "\n" + log,
            "Read the compiler line number; check GLSL version, declarations and shader inputs/outputs.");
        api.DeleteShader(shader);

        return 0;
    }

    return shader;
}

bool validLayout(const VertexLayout& layout) {
    if (!layout.stride || layout.stride > std::size_t(std::numeric_limits<GLsizei>::max()) || layout.attributes.empty())
        return false;
    GLint maximum = 0;
    gl().GetIntegerv(GL_MAX_VERTEX_ATTRIBS, &maximum);
    std::vector<GLuint> used;
    for (const auto& a : layout.attributes) {
        std::size_t bytes = 0;
        switch (a.type) {
        case GL_BYTE: case GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE: bytes = 1; break;
        case GL_SHORT: case GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT: bytes = 2; break;
        case GL_INT: case GL_UNSIGNED_INT: case GL_FLOAT: bytes = 4; break;
        default: return false;
        }
        if (a.location >= GLuint(maximum) || a.components < 1 || a.components > 4 ||
            a.offset > layout.stride || std::size_t(a.components)*bytes > layout.stride-a.offset ||
            (a.integer && (a.normalized || a.type == GL_FLOAT)) ||
            std::find(used.begin(), used.end(), a.location) != used.end())
            return false;
        used.push_back(a.location);
    }
    return true;
}

GLuint uploadTexture(const TextureImage& image, bool repeat) {
    auto& api = gl();
    GLuint id = 0;

    api.GenTextures(1, &id);

    if (!id) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Asset, "glGenTextures", "Texture allocation failed.");

        return 0;
    }
    api.ActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0);
    api.BindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, id);

    GLint previousAlignment = 4;

    api.GetIntegerv(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, &previousAlignment);
    api.PixelStorei(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 1);
    api.TexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL_RGBA8, GLsizei(image.width), GLsizei(image.height), 0, GL_RGBA,
                   GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, image.rgba.data());
    api.PixelStorei(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, previousAlignment);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, repeat ? GL_REPEAT : GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, repeat ? GL_REPEAT : GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);

    if (!checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Asset, "uploadTexture")) {
        api.DeleteTextures(1, &id);

        return 0;
    }

    return id;
}
} // namespace detail

bool Renderer::initShader(const std::filesystem::path& vertexPath, const std::filesystem::path& fragmentPath) {
    auto& gl = detail::gl();
    const auto vertexText = vertexPath.empty() ? std::string(detail::vertexShader) : readTextFile(vertexPath);
    const auto fragmentText = fragmentPath.empty() ? std::string(detail::fragmentShader) : readTextFile(fragmentPath);

    if (vertexText.empty() || fragmentText.empty())
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "Renderer::initShader",
            "Shader source is empty or unreadable: vertex=" + vertexPath.u8string() +
                "; fragment=" + fragmentPath.u8string(),
            "Use embedded shaders (empty shaderDirectory), or copy both GLSL files to the configured project-relative directory.");
    // /utf-8 /FC encodes __FILE__ as UTF-8, not the Windows ANSI code page.
    const auto embeddedSource = std::filesystem::u8path(__FILE__).parent_path() / "Shaders.h";
    const auto vertex =
        detail::compileShader(GL_VERTEX_SHADER, vertexText, vertexPath.empty() ? embeddedSource : vertexPath);

    if (!vertex)
        return false;

    const auto fragment =
        detail::compileShader(GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragmentText, fragmentPath.empty() ? embeddedSource : fragmentPath);

    if (!fragment) {
        gl.DeleteShader(vertex);

        return false;
    }
    shaderProgramID_ = gl.CreateProgram();

    if (!shaderProgramID_) {
        gl.DeleteShader(vertex);
        gl.DeleteShader(fragment);

        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "glCreateProgram",
                                   "Program allocation failed.");
    }
    gl.AttachShader(shaderProgramID_, vertex);
    gl.AttachShader(shaderProgramID_, fragment);
    gl.LinkProgram(shaderProgramID_);
    gl.DeleteShader(vertex);
    gl.DeleteShader(fragment);

    GLint success = 0;

    gl.GetProgramiv(shaderProgramID_, GL_LINK_STATUS, &success);

    if (!success) {
        GLint size = 0;

        gl.GetProgramiv(shaderProgramID_, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &size);

        std::string log(std::max(size, 1), '\0');

        gl.GetProgramInfoLog(shaderProgramID_, GLsizei(log.size()), nullptr, log.data());

        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "glLinkProgram", log,
                                   "Match vertex outputs and fragment inputs; inspect the linker log.");
    }
    mvpLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.mvp.c_str());
    modelLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.model.c_str());
    normalLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.normal.c_str());
    textureLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.texture.c_str());
    hasTextureLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.hasTexture.c_str());
    lightingLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.lighting.c_str());
    lightDirectionLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.lightDirection.c_str());
    lightColorLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.lightColor.c_str());
    overrideLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.overrideColor.c_str());
    outlineColorLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.outlineColor.c_str());
    tintLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.tint.c_str());

    return mvpLocation_ >= 0 || (config_.uniforms.mvp.empty() && bool(config_.bindUniforms)) || Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "glGetUniformLocation",
                                                    "Required MVP uniform is missing or optimized away: " + config_.uniforms.mvp);
}

bool Renderer::initialize(const std::filesystem::path& vertexPath, const std::filesystem::path& fragmentPath,
                          const RenderConfig& config) {
    detail::gl().load();
    if (!detail::validLayout(config.vertexLayout) ||
        (!config.packVertices && config.vertexLayout.stride != sizeof(RenderVertex)))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::initialize",
                                   "Invalid layout, or custom stride without a vertex packer.");
    const auto nextConfig = config; // Copy before destroying resources; config may alias current settings.
    destroy();
    config_ = nextConfig;

    if (!initShader(vertexPath, fragmentPath)) {
        destroy();

        return false;
    }

    auto& gl = detail::gl();

    gl.GenVertexArrays(1, &vao_);
    gl.GenBuffers(1, &vbo_);
    gl.GenBuffers(1, &ebo_);

    if (!vao_ || !vbo_ || !ebo_) {
        destroy();

        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::initialize",
                                   "VAO/VBO/EBO allocation failed.");
    }
    gl.BindVertexArray(vao_);
    gl.BindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, vbo_);
    gl.BindBuffer(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, ebo_);
    for (const auto& attribute : config_.vertexLayout.attributes) {
        const auto pointer = reinterpret_cast<const void*>(attribute.offset);
        if (attribute.integer)
            gl.VertexAttribIPointer(attribute.location, attribute.components, attribute.type,
                                    GLsizei(config_.vertexLayout.stride), pointer);
        else
            gl.VertexAttribPointer(attribute.location, attribute.components, attribute.type,
                                   attribute.normalized ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE,
                                   GLsizei(config_.vertexLayout.stride), pointer);
        gl.EnableVertexAttribArray(attribute.location);
    }
    gl.BindVertexArray(0);
    gl.BindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0);

    return detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::initialize vertex layout");
}

bool Renderer::upload(const Scene& scene, bool textureMode) {
    Diagnostics::trace(PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload");

    std::vector<RenderVertex> vertices;
    std::vector<GLuint> indices;
    std::vector<DrawRange> ranges;
    TextureMap stagedTextures;
    auto& gl = detail::gl();
    auto cleanup = [&]() {
        for (const auto& item : stagedTextures)
            gl.DeleteTextures(1, &item.second);
    };

    try {
        for (auto id : scene.getIds()) {
            const auto* c = scene.getComponent(id);

            if (c && c->transformOnly)
                continue;

            if (!c || !DiagramSystem::validPolyhedron(c->polyhedron)) {
                cleanup();

                return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload",
                                           "Missing component or invalid mesh, indices, colors, UVs or normals.",
                                           "Inspect the entity's mesh data before GPU upload.", id);
            }

            for (std::size_t faceIndex = 0; faceIndex < c->polyhedron.faces.size(); ++faceIndex) {
                const auto& face = c->polyhedron.faces[faceIndex];

                if (vertices.size() + face.localVertices.size() > std::numeric_limits<GLuint>::max()) {
                    cleanup();

                    return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload",
                                               "Vertex count exceeds the GPU index range.");
                }

                const auto first = GLuint(vertices.size());
                Mesh normals = face;

                if (normals.vertexNormals.empty())
                    recalculateNormals(normals);

                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < face.localVertices.size(); ++i) {
                    const auto p = face.localVertices[i];
                    const auto n = normals.vertexNormals[i];
                    auto color = face.vertexColors.empty() ? face.color : face.vertexColors[i];

                    color.red *= face.material.color.red;
                    color.green *= face.material.color.green;
                    color.blue *= face.material.color.blue;

                    const auto uv = face.texcoords.empty() ? glm::vec2(0) : face.texcoords[i];

                    vertices.push_back(
                        {{p.x, p.y, p.z}, {color.red, color.green, color.blue}, {uv.x, uv.y}, {n.x, n.y, n.z}});
                }

                const auto triangles = detail::triangles(face);
                const auto outline =
                    meshOutline(face, face.outline == OutlineMode::None ? OutlineMode::FeatureEdges : face.outline);

                if (triangles.size() > std::numeric_limits<GLsizei>::max() ||
                    outline.size() > std::numeric_limits<GLsizei>::max()) {
                    cleanup();

                    return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload",
                                               "Draw count exceeds GLsizei range.");
                }

                DrawRange range;

                range.entityId = id;
                range.faceIndex = faceIndex;
                range.firstIndex = indices.size();
                range.count = GLsizei(triangles.size());

                for (auto index : triangles)
                    indices.push_back(first + index);
                range.outlineFirstIndex = indices.size();
                range.outlineCount = GLsizei(outline.size());

                for (auto index : outline)
                    indices.push_back(first + index);
                ranges.push_back(range);

                if (textureMode && face.material.useTexture &&
                    stagedTextures.find(face.material.texture) == stagedTextures.end()) {
                    if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Asset, "before uploadTexture")) {
                        cleanup();

                        return false;
                    }

                    const auto texture = detail::uploadTexture(*face.material.texture, face.material.repeatTexture);

                    if (!texture) {
                        cleanup();

                        return false;
                    }

                    try {
````
